scope: Read-only source and active receipt checks; no execution of stages by reviewer. This does not certify the outcome of the running numerical-accuracy screen.
controls_verified: Original stopped-no-retry status and plan hash retained; all three completed result hashes rechecked.
One explicit original-plan stage and source hash; no sampling or exact-correction stage is allowed.
Fresh exclusive receipt and per-stage attempt/log files; refusal to overwrite completed outputs.
Fresh summarize_run qualification precedes each stage.
Native child refuses existing result files and treats log-without-record as an incomplete attempt without rerunning.
Scientific status copied verbatim; execution_complete is not scientific qualification.
All four required environment flags are set to1 for the child.
limitations: Wrapper checks its own/source/failed-plan bytes before each stage, not again after the last subprocess; the native child separately rechecks bound identities on completion.

A distinct future receipt is not a global execution lock; the native cache itself protects completed/incomplete point attempts. Concurrent launches into one cache are outside this reviewed authorized use.
